```{r}
library(knitr)
library(glue)
library(sqlife)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)
```

# Data Info
```{r}
db <- ifelse(interactive(), "local/narrate.db",  "../local/narrate.db")

rubric_version <- 3
last_modified <- format(file.info(db)$mtime, "%B %-d, %Y")

conn <- dbGetConn(db)

review_info <- tbl(conn, "review_assignment") |>
  left_join(
    tbl(conn, "reviewer") |> select(reviewer_id = id, human, username),
    by = "reviewer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    tbl(conn, "evaluation") |> select(evaluation_id = id, summary_flg),
    by = "evaluation_id"
  ) |>
  filter(
    ((human == 1 & rubric_id == rubric_version & statusCode == 2) |
      (human == 0 & rubric_id == rubric_version & statusCode == 5)) &
      summary_flg == 0
  ) |>
  collect()

reviews_by_user <- review_info |> group_by(reviewer_id, username) |> summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
reviews_by_user |> kable()
HTML(glue("Data last modified {last_modified} with latest rubric {rubric_version}"))
```


```{r}
dbFinish(conn)
```
